function: ISS-PPO deep RL controls sink-node transmit power with AAV path selection, and AAV transmit power with sub-band allocation on AAV-to-LEO links (pp. 8-9).
system: Three-hop uplink: LoRa sensors to single-antenna sink nodes, sinks to AAV with K=4 receive beams, AAV to LEO with NOMA, e.g. Ka band; no RIS (pp. 4, 11).
method: Improved PPO (ISS-PPO: independent action components, self-attention, strict-hard constraint); multi-agent DRL for P1, single-agent for P2; reinforcement learning in simulation (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: 10 km x 10 km region, 6 areas, 100-300 sensors per area, 30 LEO satellites; LoS/NLoS loss and a,b coefficients in Table I; no dataset (p. 11).
test_conditions: One simulated setup (p. 11); results swept over AAV battery capacity (p. 12), number of sub-bands (p. 13), load levels (p. 14); no separate unseen test condition stated.
baselines: Non-learned: MDFP, SDFP, RPRP, TDFP (fixed or random power); learned: SI-PSPC, FDPC, TDPC, FTPC are variants of ISS-PPO; BCD of [18] compared only by complexity (pp. 11-12).
metrics: Data transmission amount, data backlog, energy consumption, energy transmission efficiency (ETE), spectrum transmission efficiency (STE), transmission delay, Jain's fairness; required sub-bands and AAV panel capacity (pp. 12-14).
complexity: Big-O time complexity of ISS-PPO training for P1 and P2 and of the DIA, in layers, neurons, rounds; compared with BCD of [18]; no runtime (pp. 10-11).
openness: none stated; p. 1 footnote: supplementary material at https://doi.org/10.1109/JIOT.2024.3522344, content not described as code or data
q1_support: p. 11: "Other parameters are listed in Table I." Table I gives LoS/NLoS excessive path loss and channel coefficients a, b (9.61, 0.16) of the authors' own simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO model or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 13: "we explore the performance of five schemes under different numbers of sub-bands"; Algorithm 2 (p. 11) retrains at each value ("to train model M2 for solving local problem"). No trained model is tested in a scenario unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 12: "The AAV randomly selects a group to serve at each step, and sink nodes use random power" is a non-learned baseline, but the learned comparisons are ISS-PPO variants (SI-PSPC: "One decision guides the AAV through multiple steps"; FDPC, TDPC, FTPC change only the access scheme). No earlier learned method or standard DRL such as PPO or DQN is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "time complexity of solving problem P1 as O(" and p. 11: "the time complexity of our DIA for GP" are given as Big-O expressions in layers, neurons, training rounds, and time slots.
q5_support: p. 1: "supplementary downloadable material available at https://doi.org/10.1109/JIOT.2024.3522344", but the paper does not say it holds code or data; p. 11: the setup is the authors' own simulation ("Other parameters are listed in Table I.").
notes: Included, area 6 (power and resource control of aerial and satellite links). Passes above_phy because the learned policy sets AAV transmit power and sub-band allocation on AAV-LEO links jointly with path selection (p. 9: "the power control Pm,i of AAV Um,i in each time slot"). q5: only the p. 1 supplementary-material footnote exists, so the reviewer should check what it contains. q3: SI-PSPC, FDPC, TDPC and FTPC reuse ISS-PPO. Table I (p. 11) was read from the page image because the text extraction omits it.
